rationale.tail_direction_remove_0.1: Partially remove the common hidden-activation direction with negative projections onto the 12 outer-gap rows. Median and central interval untouched; no labels used to derive the direction.
rationale.tail_direction_remove_0.25: Stronger removal of the same weight-derived direction, testing whether input-dependent suppression explains undercoverage.
rationale.tail_direction_remove_0.5: Half removal of the same direction; a stronger causal intervention.
rationale.disconnect_two_tail_neurons: Zero the outer-gap connections of the two hidden units with the most negative mean outer-gap weights, retaining their median/inner-gap connections.
rationale.disconnect_four_tail_neurons: Same surgical edit for four units.
rationale.disconnect_eight_tail_neurons: Same surgical edit for eight units.
